notes: 29 playable agents as of patch 13.06 (released 2026-09-22); newest is Miks (Controller, patch 12.05, March 2026). Miks is 'Agent 30' in lore numbering because Agent 08 exists in lore but is unplayable; the official wiki's '30 total' header counts that, its role lists sum to 29. No new agent in 13.00-13.06; one is announced for after Champions 2026 but unreleased/unnamed. Portraits are official full-body agent renders (350x350 RGBA, transparent) from one consistent source; no complete set of bust/display icons >=128px was reachable, so faces are small. Forward pick changed: ivy Sage->Miks (Harmonize ally stim mirrors Kudzu Connection). Matches are looser than in hero games since Valorant is tactical.
